title: What's the weather like?
subtitle: Rain in Boston, sun in Amman — questions with -ing
canDo: I can ask and talk about the weather.
I can ask questions like Are you working? and What are you doing?
I can give short answers: Yes, I am. / No, it isn't.
teacherNotes: Hava kelimelerini karşılaştırın: rain (isim/fiil) → It's raining / It's rainy. snow → It's snowing / It's snowy. sunny, cloudy, windy ise sadece sıfat.
ABD'de sıcaklık Fahrenheit ile verilir (50°F ≈ 10°C). Merak eden olursa gösterin; derste Celsius kullandık.
Kısa cevap çalışması: "Is it raining now? Are you sitting? Are you drinking tea?" gibi hızlı sorular sorun; tam cümleyle değil "Yes, I am. / No, I'm not." ile cevaplasınlar.
Ödev fikri: öğrenciler kendi şehirlerinin bugünkü havasını yazıp WhatsApp'tan göndersin.

sections.title: Listen and read
sections.heading: Rain and sun
sections.scene: Omar is walking home from the hospital. His sister Lina calls from Amman.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Omar! Where are you? I can't see you.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: I'm walking home from the hospital. It's raining, and it's very windy.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Yes, I am … but look at it!

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Ha ha! Poor Omar. Here it's sunny and hot. It's twenty-eight degrees.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Twenty-eight? It's only twelve degrees here. What are you doing?

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: I'm sitting in the garden with Mom. We're drinking tea.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: No, he isn't. He's visiting Grandma Fatima.

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Is it cold at night in Amman now?

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: No, it isn't. It's warm. What's the weather like in Boston in winter?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: Very cold. Sometimes it snows a lot.

lines.speaker: lina
lines.text: Snow! Send me a photo, OK?

lines.speaker: omar
lines.text: OK. But now I'm going home. I'm very cold!

sections.title: Grammar: questions with -ing
look: **What's the weather like?** — It's sunny and hot.
rules: Short answers: Yes, I **am**. (not Yes, I'm.) · No, it **isn't**.
With a question word: **What are** you do**ing**? **Where is** she go**ing**?
Weather: **It's** sunny / cloudy / windy. **It's** rain**ing** / snow**ing**.
examples: What's the weather like in Izmir?

support.tr: Soru için am / is / are başa gelir: You are working → Are you working? = Çalışıyor musun? Kısa cevapta sadece am / is / are kullanılır: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. Hava durumunda Türkçede özne yoktur (Yağmur yağıyor), ama İngilizcede it gerekir: It's raining. It's sunny.
support.ar: للسؤال نضع am / is / are في البداية: You are working → Are you working? = هل تعمل الآن؟ وفي الجواب القصير نستخدم am / is / are فقط: Yes, I am. / No, I'm not. وفي الطقس نقول بالعربية «تمطر» بدون فاعل ظاهر، أمّا بالإنجليزية فلا بدّ من it: It's raining. It's sunny.

tr.note: Hava durumunda it'i unutma. Kısa olumlu cevapta I'm değil, I am de.

ar.note: في السؤال ضع is / are قبل الفاعل، ولا تنسَ it مع الطقس.

sections.title: Practice
items: {Is} it snowing in Boston? — No, it isn't.
{Are} you listening to me? — Yes, I am.
What {are} they doing? — They're drinking tea.
Is Omar walking home? — Yes, he {is}.
Is it hot in Boston today? — No, it {isn't}.

text: It's cold and cloudy in Boston today.
I'm sitting in the library, and I'm drinking a hot coffee.
